Rounding to n Decimal Places
Avrunding til n desimale steder

In general, a calculator or computer is unable to store every decimal place of a real number. Real numbers are . To round a number to \(n\) decimal places we look at the \((n+1)^{th}\) digit in the decimal expansion of the number. Generelt er en kalkulator eller datamaskin ikke i stand til å lagre hvert desimalt sted med et reelt tall.Reelle tall er.For å runde et tall til \ (n \) desimalsteder ser vi på \ ((n+1)^{th} \) sifferet i desimalutvidelsen av tallet.

  • If the \((n+1)^{th}\) digit is 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 then we : that is, we simply chop to \(n\) places. (In other words we neglect the \((n+1)^{th}\) digit and any digits to its right.)
  • If the \((n+1)^{th}\) digit is 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9 then we : we add \(1\) to the \(n^{th}\) decimal place and then chop to \(n\) places.

For example For eksempel

\(\qquad\qquad\qquad\begin{aligned} \dfrac{1}{3} &= 0.3333 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 4 decimal places} \\ \pi &= 3.14159 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 5 decimal places}\\ \dfrac{8}{3} &= 2.667 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 3 decimal places}\\ 2136 &= 2000.000 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 3 decimal places}\\ 36.8 &= 37 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 1 decimal place}\\ 6.2399 &= 6.240 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 3 decimal places} \end{aligned}\) \(\qquad\qquad\qquad\begin{aligned} \dfrac{1}{3} &= 0.3333 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 4 decimal places} \\ \pi &= 3.14159 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 5 decimal places}\\ \dfrac{8}{3} &= 2.667 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 3 decimal places}\\ 2136 &= 2000.000 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 3 decimal places}\\ 36.8 &= 37 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 1 decimal place}\\ 6.2399 &= 6.240 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 3 decimal places} \end{aligned}\)

Example Eksempel

Write down each of these numbers rounded to 4 decimal places: Skriv ned hvert av disse tallene avrundet til 4 desimaler:

  1. \(0.12345\)
  2. \(-0.44444\)
  3. \(0.5555555\)
  4. \(0.000127351\)
  5. \(0.000005\)
  6. \(123.456789\)

Solution Løsning

  1. \(0.12345\) rounded to 4 decimal place becomes \(0.1235.\)
  2. \(-0.44444\) rounded to 4 decimal place becomes \(-0.4444.\)
  3. \(0.5555555\) rounded to 4 decimal place becomes \(0.5556.\)
  4. \(0.000127351\) rounded to 4 decimal place becomes \(0.0001.\)
  5. \(0.000005\) rounded to 4 decimal place becomes \(0.0000.\)
  6. \(123.456789\) rounded to 4 decimal place becomes \(123.4568.\)
